facts.fact: 深渊无底：坠落即死，木吊桥是唯一通路
facts.anchor: A fall from this height would mean instant death.

facts.fact: 魔法双斧首秀：金丝自掌心织成两柄战斧（看台惊叹、Larissa 张口）
facts.anchor: Tendrils of gold wove outwards from the centres of her palms

facts.fact: 魔法斧坚不可摧：把士兵的剑削成两半
facts.anchor: her axes cut through the metal with zero resistance, splitting the weapon in two

facts.fact: 桥索断裂的一瞬：时间近乎凝滞，她用盾泡把 Felix 悬空包住
facts.anchor: the harsh rocketing of the wooden bridge as it swayed from side to side

facts.fact: 盾泡=替人扛体重：她 6'4 扛 6'6 肌肉 Felix，很快见底
facts.anchor: Inara was tall, roughly 6’4, but Felix was 6’6, and mostly all muscle.

facts.fact: 盾墙把四兵挤成「贴墙陈列」，只为吓——「让边境的力量被记住」
facts.anchor: Let it be a warning to those who underestimated the power that lurked in the Borderlands.

facts.fact: 门后虚脱争执：Felix 只在她有性命之忧时才叫她 Nara；她发誓「太过了就退出」
facts.anchor: Felix only called her Nara when he was scared for her.
